messages:
maya: Support ticket: several customers sending "mixed-size" embed payloads get a terse 413 and no guidance. They expect a hint to auto-split. Can we add a small advisory header that recommends a split plan + cost/latency estimate?
aj: I like an advisory-only header. Suggest key `X-Embed-AutoSplit-Advice` with fields: dims, bytes, units_est, plan, est_split_total_units, est_split_reqs, est_split_p95_ms. Keep it non-enforced and parseable.

kevin: Important constraints: Dedicated tenants must opt in from admin console. Do NOT leak exact quota or billing numbers in headers. Always return only estimates. Also version the header like `X-Embed-AutoSplit-Advice-v1`.

maya: Console/telemetry ask: we currently only have 413 counts. Add metrics `embed.autosplit.advice_sent` and `embed.autosplit.advice_applied`. Tag by tenant, route, rollout_phase. Also emit `ingest.request_multiplier` to measure ops impact.
sara: Rollout plan: hosted canary 3% for 7d with canary tag, then 15% if stable, then 100% after two successful cycles. SDK flag `enable_autosplit_advice=false` by default; auto-apply behind opt-in.
tom: Operational risk: auto-splitting multiplies internal requests. Include `est_split_reqs` and `est_split_total_units` so SDKs can decide when to do parallel vs sequential. Also runtime should provide `est_split_p95_ms` so SDKs know latency tradeoffs.
aj: Example header value (compact): `X-Embed-AutoSplit-Advice-v1: dims=1024;bytes=420000;units_est=6;plan=3x341;est_split_reqs=3;est_split_total_units=7;est_split_p95_ms=140`. SDKs can parse by semicolon.

kevin: Add server-side opt-out per tenant: `embed.autosplit_advice.enabled=false` and an audit log entry when admin flips it. Unit tests must ensure header suppressed for opt-out tenants and for Dedicated default.
maya: Console UI: add a small Support snippet in Agents panel: "If you see Payload Too Large, split into ~N vectors of size ~M or enable SDK auto-splitting via feature flag." Also add a tiny dashboard card under Embeddings showing advice_sent vs advice_applied and a heatmap of tenants seeing most advisories.
sara: I'll create the console ticket and two alerts: 1) product alert: if advice_sent/embed.requests > 0.05 AND advice_applied < 0.1 for 7d -> PM outreach; 2) ops alert: if ingest.request_multiplier > 4x baseline OR ingest.queue_depth spikes -> investigate scaling/backpressure.
tom: SDK design note: default UX shows a developer-visible warning and an actionable link. Auto-split only if `enable_autosplit_advice=true` AND `est_split_total_units <= original_units * 1.15` to avoid surprise charges. Also rate-limit auto-splits per tenant to avoid sudden campaigning storms.
aj: Implementation tasks I can take: - add header shape to runtime response path (hosted canary toggle) - wire preflight estimator to compute units_est and split plan - emit metrics: embed.autosplit.advice_sent, embed.autosplit.advice_applied, ingest.request_multiplier - include header v1 with semicolon-delimited fields

kevin: I'll add Dedicated guard rails: admin toggle, audit logs, and a policy that headers never include exact tenant quotas. Also add integration tests to verify header absent when tenant flag false.
devx-bot: Note to SDK teams: update error message template to include parsing of `X-Embed-AutoSplit-Advice-v1` and consider exposing a developer console warning. We'll coordinate releases with runtime canary schedule.
maya: Decision summary: 1) Emit `X-Embed-AutoSplit-Advice-v1` advisory header on hosted 413s under canary. 2) Header fields: dims, bytes, units_est, plan, est_split_reqs, est_split_total_units, est_split_p95_ms. 3) SDKs show warning by default, auto-apply behind opt-in + cost guard + per-tenant rate cap. 4) Console: metrics, small support blurb, and two alerts. 5) Dedicated: admin opt-in only, never leak quotas.
aj: I'll open the PR today (include unit + integration tests). Please review quickly.

kevin: SGTM. Make sure metric names and header keys are exact strings.
sara: I'll wire dashboards and schedule the canary after PR lands. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks all  I'll update support KB after canary completes. Closing thread.
